# awesome-private-ai

> A curated list of AI tools that protect data sovereignty through architecture, ranging from on-device inference to self-hosted servers.

The project is a documentation list maintained by Brethof AI, not a software library or executable application. It categorizes tools into four privacy levels, from on-device to hosted services with no-retention guarantees. Each entry includes metadata on source code availability, cost, and specific telemetry settings.

## Docs

- [awesome-private-ai](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/main/README.md): The project's purpose, the privacy ladder levels, and how it differs from awesome-local-ai regarding data sovereignty.
- [Why this list exists — and how it differs from awesome-local-ai](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#why-this-list-exists--and-how-it-differs-from-awesome-local-ai): Distinction between local and private tools, plus the four-tier privacy ladder used to categorize entries.
- [Legend](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#legend): Symbol key explaining icons for hosting type, source availability, audit status, pricing, and region.
- [Level 1 — On Your Device](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-1--on-your-device): Local AI tools where nothing leaves the machine, including Brethof Voice Pro, Hyperconsciousness, Jan, and llama.cpp.
- [Level 2 — On Your Server](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-2--on-your-server): Self-hosted AI tools where you control the hardware, including Anything LLM, Immich, LibreChat, LocalAI, and Open WebUI.
- [Level 3 — Can't See, Provably](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-3--cant-see-provably): Hosted AI tools using cryptography to prevent operator access, including Confer, Ente Photos, and Maple (OpenSecret).
- [Level 4 — Processes, Never Stores](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-4--processes-never-stores): Services with no-retention commitments, local or user-keyed storage, and verifiable data flows.
- [Open-Weights Models You Can Audit](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#open-weights-models-you-can-audit): Open-weights models you can audit and run locally, including DeepSeek V4, Gemma 4, GLM-5.3, and Kimi K3.
- [Privacy Auditing Tools](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#privacy-auditing-tools): Tools for verifying vendor privacy claims, including network interceptors, firewalls, and packet capture utilities.
- [Related work](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#related-work): Links to related lists covering local AI, license analysis, Linux distros, and MCP servers.
